reason: I'd probably poke at the 10 free sample DMs and maybe even start the trial, but I wouldn't be paying $147 a month. Other Instagram DM tools run a third to a quarter of that, and I'm an SDR working a client's leads out of a Google Sheet, not an agency owner with a margin to spend on tools.
objection: $147 is three or four times what other IG DM tools charge, and there are no customer results yet, so I'd be paying a premium for a promise. The guarantee also means I have to push 300 approved DMs in 30 days before I can claim anything, which is a lot to do just to test a tool.
would_change_my_mind: A price under about $70 a month, or published results from real founding members showing booked calls at my volume.
